fields.name: Default Care & Cleaning
fields.instructions:
To keep your garment looking its best, please hand wash carefully in cold water with a mild detergent and wash inside out. Avoid scrubbing directly on the print, using bleach, or soaking for long periods. Dry in a shaded area and avoid direct sunlight. If needed, iron inside out on low heat and never iron directly on the printed design. Following these care instructions will help maintain the fabric quality, color, fit, and print durability.
For professional cleaning, visit your local jeweler or contact our customer service team.
